gloss: for young children; aimed at toddlers

definitions.gloss: for young children; aimed at toddlers
definitions.explanation: Describes products, content, services, or activities designed or intended for young children, typically ages one to five. Functions as a noun modifier with の or as a compound modifier before another noun.

examples.japanese: {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a picture book for young children.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This program is made for young children.

examples.japanese: {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: There are so many types of English learning materials for young children that it's hard to choose.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧ (young child, toddler) and ⟦{向|む}け→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧ (aimed at, intended for). The ⟦{向|む}け→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧ suffix is highly productive and can attach to many target audiences: ⟦{子供|こども}{向|む}け→子供向け：17933_kodomomuke⟧ (for children), ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧{向|む}け (for adults), ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け→初心者向け：17934_shoshinshamuke⟧ (for beginners).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧: picture book for toddlers
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: children's TV program
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧: learning materials for young children
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: food for young children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{子供|こども}{向|む}け→子供向け：17933_kodomomuke⟧: for children — broader age range, typically up to elementary school
- {幼児用|ようじよう}: for young children's use — focuses more on physical products (seats, utensils) rather than content
- ⟦{乳幼児|にゅうようじ}→乳幼児：14882_nyuuyouji⟧{向|む}け: for infants and toddlers — includes babies under one year
